app.name: Teahouse
app.offlineMode: Offline. You can read saved chats, edit messages of the current scene and write one message; everything is sent when the server is back.

auth.setupHint: Choose a password for this server. You will use it to sign in on each device.
auth.connectHint: Enter the address of your Teahouse server, or paste a pairing link from another device.
auth.usePassword: Sign in with the password instead
auth.pairHint: On a signed-in device, open Settings → Devices → Pair a device, then enter the code or paste the link.
auth.pairLinkHint: This link signs this device in without the password. It works once and expires after five minutes.
auth.invalidCode: That is not a pairing code or link.
auth.cameraDenied: Teahouse needs the camera to scan the code. Allow it in the system settings, or paste the link instead.
auth.connectHintScan: Scan the pairing QR code shown under Settings → Pair a device on a signed-in device, or enter the server address.

server.reachable: The server answers again. Try once more.
server.gateway: The reverse proxy answers, but the Teahouse server behind it does not. Check that Teahouse is running.
server.blocked: The server answers, but the app may not read its response. A reverse proxy in front of Teahouse probably redirects the app (for example to a login page) or drops the CORS headers.
server.localNetwork: Teahouse is not allowed to access your local network, where your server probably is.
server.localNetworkRefused: Android no longer asks. Open the settings, then Permissions → Nearby devices → Allow.
server.down: Nothing answers at %{server}. Check the address, that the server is running and that this device is on the same network or VPN.
server.tlsFailed: %{server} does not answer with a secure connection. If the server runs without HTTPS, enter the address with http://.
server.untrusted: The server answers, but this device does not trust its certificate:
server.certNotYetValid: The certificate is only valid from %{date}. Check the date and time on this device.
server.certWrongHost: The certificate is not issued for %{host}. Connect with a name it lists, or issue a new one.
server.certSelfSigned: The certificate is self-signed. Install it on this device as a trusted CA certificate, or replace it with one from your own CA or a public one (see the guide below).
server.certUnknownCa: It was issued by a CA this device does not know. Install that CA in the system's certificate store, then restart Teahouse.
server.certUnknownCaAndroid: It was issued by a CA this device does not know. Install that CA under Settings → Security → Encryption & credentials → Install a certificate → CA certificate (the path varies by phone), then restart Teahouse.
server.httpsDocs: How to set up HTTPS for Teahouse

chats.pick: Pick a chat or start a new one.
chats.emptyReply: The reply came back empty. Regenerate, or check the profile in the log view.

profiles.name: Name
profiles.apiKeyStored: A key is stored. Leave empty to keep it.
profiles.empty: No profiles yet. A profile tells Teahouse which endpoint and model to use.

settings.canonReview: Review canon changes as diffs before they are committed

home.toWorlds: Create a world or import a character card.

worlds.empty: No worlds yet. A world is a folder of Markdown files with its own Git history.
worlds.name: Name
worlds.importHint: PNG or JSON, Character Card V1–V3. Lorebook entries become files in lore/.
worlds.noCharacters: No characters yet. Import a card or add a file in characters/.
worlds.importWorldHint: A .teahouse.tar.gz export: the world with its history, images and chats. A world that already exists here is imported as a copy.

scenes.title: Scene %{n}
scenes.endHint: The current path is frozen. With canon, Teahouse proposes changes to the world files for you to review.
scenes.memoryUpToHere: Active Memory: summary up to here
scenes.reviewHint: Accept, edit or reject each file. Accepted files are committed together.
scenes.resolveFirst: Edit the file and resolve the conflict markers first
scenes.apply: Commit %{count} files and close the scene
scenes.briefHint: A few words on what happens next. Teahouse proposes an opening and a cast.

vn.empty: The scene has not started yet.

images.label: Label
images.descriptionHint: What the narrator should know about this place

pairing.hint: Scan the QR code with the new device, or open the link there. You can also type the code.
pairing.qrAlt: QR code with the pairing link
pairing.loopbackHint: localhost only works on this computer. Enter an address the other device can reach.

sync.forked: The chat had moved on (on another device, or while you were offline), so your message started a new branch. The other turn is one swipe away.
sync.overwritten: This message had also been changed elsewhere. Your edit replaced that change.
sync.editClosed: Your edit could not be saved: the scene was closed in the meantime.
sync.sendFailed: Your message could not be sent (%{message}). Its text is back in the message field.

version.updateServer: This app (Teahouse %{app}) needs a newer server. The server runs Teahouse %{server}: update it, for a Docker install by pulling the latest image.
version.updateApp: The server runs Teahouse %{server}, which this app (Teahouse %{app}) is too old for. Install the latest app from the Teahouse releases.
version.reload: The server was updated to Teahouse %{server}. Reload the page to load the new version.
